post-office-cts-and-bttc-alumni-in-stone.core: Posted in last 7 days Post Office CTS & BTTC Alumni in Stone - Yarnfield Park History Did you train or work at the Post Office Central Training School (CTS) or BT Technical College (BTTC) in Stone, Staffordshire? I'm working with Yarnfield Park on the site's history. It began as wartime hostels for the ROF Swynnerton munitions workers, and from 30 September 1946 it trained generations of GPO and BT engineers. Today it's still a place of learning, as a training and conference centre. Ahead of the 81st anniversary in September 2027, I'm gathering memories, photographs and facts to tell the story properly. If you were there as a student, instructor, lecturer or member of staff, or you know someone who was, I'd be very glad to hear from you. Did you come to Stone from British Rail, the NHS or a Commonwealth telecoms administration? I'd love to hear from you too. Please comment below or send me a message. If we are not yet connected on LinkedIn, feel free to send a connection request with a short note. holmes-bulldogs-alumni-and-pep-band-in-c.headline: Holmes Bulldogs Alumni & Pep Band in Covington - Coach Flynn Memories
holmes-bulldogs-alumni-and-pep-band-in-c.author: CincyCartoons / Cincinnati Sports
holmes-bulldogs-alumni-and-pep-band-in-c.core: Posted in last 7 days Holmes Bulldogs Alumni & Pep Band in Covington - Coach Flynn Memories The pickle sets the screen. The dinner roll breaks for the basket. Doug Schloemer has a clean passing lane, provided nobody reaches across the placemat for the mustard. Somewhere in Covington, a waiter is wondering how long you can hold the bread before they call three seconds. That’s the play we drew up for Coach Reynolds Flynn. The best part of the picture is the guy across the table. Decades after Schloemer played basketball for Flynn at Holmes High School, the two still met for lunch every other month. Imagine telling a teenage Bulldog, halfway through one of Flynn’s conditioning drills, that someday he’d willingly spend his lunch hour with the man who made him run. Then imagine telling him he’d still be doing it nearly 50 years later. Doug probably would’ve wanted to know one thing first. Does lunch involve running? Flynn coached Holmes for 18 seasons. His Bulldogs won five Ninth Region titles, and his 1978 team took Shelby County to overtime in the state final. Covington fans followed the team bus. The players wore candy-cane warmup pants. If you somehow lost that caravan, buddy, that was on you. Then there was freshman Bud Wimzie. He found his name on the team list and headed home happy. Down at the bottom was the part about practice after school. Somewhere between making the team and missing its first practice, Bud got his first lesson from Coach Flynn. Read all the way to the bottom. Here’s what I hope people remember about Flynn, who died Nov. 5 at 90. After games, he made a point of thanking the pep band. Years later, he was still asking former players about their families. And when Doug pulled up a chair, Coach kept making time for him. If you played for Flynn, played in that band or rode behind that bus, what’s the Coach Flynn story you’d tell over lunch? I’d especially like to hear from the pep band on this one. Reunion photos by Charles Bolton. Cartoon by KJ Cincy Cartoons. Click the link to view the accompanying article... https://t.co/BuyhHSpxJZ By Evan Dennison (@EvanDennison1), @Linknky #HolmesBasketball #HolmesAthletics #HolmesBulldogs #NorthernKentucky #CincyCartoons
